context: Sho-young watches a soccer match on TV with Daichi.
purpose: Father and son sharing sport excitement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、ボール、すごく飛んだ!
lines.en: Dad — the ball went super far!
lines.style: Bright, almost breathless excitement. Small voice climbing in pitch on the middle words. Wonder and pride layered together. Natural pause before the punchline.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、角から、ようけ広がって攻めとる。
lines.en: Yeah — they're spreading out the attack from the corner!
lines.style: Warm, animated Kansai accent. Energetic lean forward on 'spreading.' Still watching intently. The comfortable commentary of a dad who knows the game and loves sharing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 実況、応援、呼ぶ声、聞こえる?
lines.en: Can you hear the commentary and the crowd cheering?
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious. Lifting slightly at the end like he's checking something with his dad. Not performing — just noticing something and wanting to share it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、皆、開きやすい場所、攻めとる!
lines.en: Yeah — everyone's attacking the open spaces!
lines.style: Warm Kansai inflection. Confident, teaching-without-lecturing tone. Slightly slower, savoring the moment of explaining the game to his son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Which team do you think will win?
lines.style: Bright, eager pitch climbing slightly upward. Hopeful and open — genuinely interested in what his dad thinks. No rush in the question.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 答えるの、難しい、最後まで応援!
lines.en: That's a tough one. Let's cheer them on all the way to the end!
lines.style: Warm, slightly laugh-touched. Decisive shift from thinking to action. Generous opening to draw his son in. Passion without pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah, come on — you got this!
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious cheer. Small voice but totally committed. Natural energy surge. The unfiltered enthusiasm of a child caught up in the moment.
